title: Security Engineer Roadmap
summary: Build a strong engineering foundation first, then combine secure systems, networking, cloud, automation and defensive security to design and operate security controls.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a four-year B.Tech/B.E. beginning in 2026 and graduation around 2030. Shift the years if your programme has a different duration.

blocks.text: 4-year honours variant

If you choose the four-year honours route, use the additional year for advanced security engineering, a substantial research project, an industry placement or a dissertation involving cloud, application, infrastructure or security automation. The honours year is not automatically required for an entry-level Security Engineer role.

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: Move from implementing individual controls toward designing security platforms and architectures. Build expertise in cloud-native systems, software supply-chain security, identity, security automation and AI-assisted engineering while retaining strong systems fundamentals.

items.text: DevSecOps and Software Supply Chain Security

blocks.text: Senior Security Engineers can remain relevant by moving toward security architecture, platform engineering, cloud-native security, software supply-chain security, security automation and technical leadership. Continue building hands-on capability because security architecture decisions depend on understanding how systems actually operate and fail.
